fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. The nations are told, “Let them present their witnesses to vindicate them…” (Isaiah 43:9). The point is that others may hear and say it is true. This is a courtroom kind of moment. Whoever speaks needs someone to back them up.

That's it, baker. God says He will bring them from the east and gather them from the west (Isaiah 43:5). Then He says to the north, “Give them up!” and to the south, “Do not hold them back!” (Isaiah 43:6). That's four directions in all.

Sheep and lambs are lovely, but they aren't the words in this verse. The LORD says, “Bring My sons from afar, and My daughters from the ends of the earth…” (Isaiah 43:6). It's a family word, and it's a warm one. Funny how one word can change the whole feel of a sentence.
No piles of gold are asked for. The text says, “Let them present their witnesses to vindicate them…” (Isaiah 43:9). It's witnesses, not stuff. A shiny pile of treasure can't testify.
Careful, baker, this one flips it. The LORD says, “Before Me no god was formed, and after Me none will come.” (Isaiah 43:10). So no god was formed before Him. And none will come after Him, either.

That's it. He says, “Before Me no god was formed, and after Me none will come.” (Isaiah 43:10). No god was formed before Him, and none will come after, friend. There's no line of other gods ahead of Him waiting for a turn.
That's not what the verse says. The LORD says, “I, yes I, am the LORD, and there is no Savior but Me.” (Isaiah 43:11). He doesn't add any helpers to that list. The saving is His, baker.

Golden sounds fancy, but it's not in the verse. The LORD says, “I alone decreed and saved and proclaimed—I, and not some foreign god among you.” (Isaiah 43:12). The word is "foreign," not a type of metal.
Yes, baker. The LORD says, “Even from eternity I am He, and none can deliver out of My hand.” (Isaiah 43:13). Nobody can deliver out of His hand. That's about as strong as a statement gets.

The verse says the opposite. The LORD says, “Even from eternity I am He, and none can deliver out of My hand.” (Isaiah 43:13). So no one can deliver out of His hand. That's the LORD's own word on it, friend.
